inventory.sectionBody:
Scope and method: inspected production operator registries, their agent-tool entrypoints, imported generic registry contracts, package manifests and database registry migrations. Searches covered registerX functions, REGISTRY/CATALOG constants and registry/catalog filenames; runtime records such as sessions, process callbacks and RPC handlers were separated from authorable behavior. A file-level name match alone is not evidence of a missing authoring tool. This is an inventory of operator behavior extension surfaces, not an assertion about dormant third-party apps.

Classification: A = an existing creation surface; B = code by design, because it implements execution/authorization or derives a read model; C = a confirmed agent-authoring gap. “No MCP tool” and “requires source edits” are distinguished below.

| Surface / runtime registry | Class | Creation path or reason; source evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Tools / tool definitions, resources, emitted-key metadata | A | meta:define-tool, tools:scaffold; agent-tools/tools/define.ts; libs/generic/tooldef/src/{registry,resource-registry,emits-registry,prompt-registry}.ts. Tool implementation still requires executable code; declaring a tool does not grant it. |
| Datatype registry | A | meta:define-datatype, datatypes:install; agent-tools/datatypes/declare.ts; libs/db/sql/421-datatype-registry.sql. |
| Capability-class registry | A | classes:define; agent-tools/classes/define.ts; libs/db/sql/1140-capability-class-registry.sql. |
| Identities, blueprint inheritance, roles | A | identities:create, blueprint:extend/create; agent-tools/identities/create.ts, blueprint/extend.ts; role-registry.ts scans built-ins and plugin roles. Authoring does not widen ceilings. |
| Local async/sync rules and installed rules | A | rules:create/validate/test/enable/disable/delete; events/local-rule-store.ts; events/registry.ts; cupboard/rule-store.ts. Installed packages stay inert until worn. |
| Event vocabulary and declarations | A | events:emit save:true; event-key-registry-store.ts, events/saved-event-type.ts. EVENT_CATALOG is the code-derived first-party tier, not the only authoring path. |
| Watches, predicate interests, composed awaits | A | watch:create, events:await; events/await/{interest-watch,predicate-watch,compose,store}.ts. |
| External triggers, webhooks and tool bindings | A | triggers:create/create-webhook/bind; agent-tools/triggers/. Transport adapters remain executable plugin/source code. |
| Plans, schedules, goals, fleets, pots, harnesses | A | plans:new/set-schedule/arm-schedule, goals:create, fleet:create, pot:create, harness:create; agent-tools/{plans,goals,fleet_registry,pot,harness}/. Recurrence uses plans, not new system routines. |
| Rubrics and repeatable measurements | A | rubrics:propose/amend with structured tests/sql/probe checks, scorecards:emit fromLedger:true. rubric-instrument-registry.ts explicitly recommends structured checks for unregistered instrument keys. |
| Facts, conventions, plan rulings | A | facts:assert and plans:add-decision; conventions/registry.ts joins those sources rather than introducing another store. |
| Lock resources and fleet invariants | A | locks:register_resource; fleet:invariant register operation; agent-tools/locks/register_resource.ts, fleet/invariant.ts. |
| Topics, knowledge packs, recipes, saved outputs | A | topics:create, knowledge_packs:publish/install, recipes:revise, reports:publish; corresponding agent-tools families and Cupboard package stores. |
| Provider integrations and plugin contributions | A | cupboard:install-plugin plus validated papercusp.json descriptors; plugin-host-runtime.ts; integrations/provider-registry.ts. New provider handlers are code, not inert data. |
| Accounts, local inference backends, service bindings | A | accounts:register/link, gateway:local_backend_register, setup:save_integration_key; deployment/account-pool.ts, inference-gateway/local-backend-store.ts. Credentials remain outside source trees. |
| Voice channels | A | voice:channels operation surface; voice-node/registry.ts createVoiceChannel/removeVoiceChannel; not a missing notification transport registry. |
| Artifact, deployment-driver, seed-bundle, release-kit and memory backend registries | B | libs/generic/{artifact-registry,deployment-driver,seed-bundle,tauri-release-kit,memory}/src. These dispatch executable host implementations; user artifacts/configuration use existing product tools. |
| State cells / assessed resolver registry | C | cell-registry.ts registerCell and cell-registrations.ts supply executable resolvers; state:read/subscribe only consume registered cells. Add declarative cells over existing authorized tool/projection/check surfaces, not arbitrary resolver code or a second state store. |
| Custom theme authoring | C (agent API parity) | custom-themes.ts saveCustomTheme and endpoint-route/routes/themes/index.ts PUT already support no-code UI/API creation. cupboard:publish-theme only exports an existing theme. Add a thin tool over that validator/store; this is NOT a code-only storage gap. |
| App/aspect template authoring | C | cupboard/template-store.ts reads self-describing template.yaml + GUIDE.md; templates:list/get-guide/new-app and cupboard install/publish consume existing templates. Creation currently requires writing that maintained package by hand. Extend template-kit/package validation for draft/validate/save; do not add another materializer. |
| Lexicon pack authoring | C | libs/generic/lexicon/src/packs.ts defines the packs; lexicon/configure.ts chooses the active pack; lexicon:active_pack only reads it. Add validated custom packs via the existing resolver rather than changing kernel terminology ad hoc. |
| Health signals, alarms and conditions | A/B split | User monitoring can already compose structured rubric checks, schedules and watch:create. signal-actor-registry.ts defineSignal and service-health-events.ts implement built-in detectors/acting-consumer invariants; these executable implementations remain B. A condition occurrence is evidence, not a user-defined detector. |
| Registered command/probe instrument implementations | B | rubric-instrument-registry.ts holds trusted argv/parsers and rejects unknown instrumentKey values. Existing structured checks cover agent-authored measurements; exposing arbitrary parser/command registration would change execution authority. |
| Pre-prompt / result wire-format registry | B | agent-tools/pre-prompt-registry-config.ts and libs/generic/result-encoding/src/registry.ts govern schema/encoding compatibility. Caller formatting/projection options are existing customization; editing fleet-wide positional schemas is a protocol change. |
| Flags, modes, hook sinks, role ceilings and kernel | B | flags registry, modes/registry.ts, orchestrator blueprint HOOK_SINKS; mode:set/flags:set change registered state, not the set of authority-bearing definitions. |
| Notification delivery transports | B | attention-notify-store.ts claimAttentionNotifyChannel restricts mobile/desktop; notifyAttention uses paired transports. Slack notifier is an existing plugin. Agent routing uses watch/coord/notifications tools; adding authenticated transports is provider/plugin implementation, not a free-form channel row. |
| System actions, autonomous admission and reverter handlers | B | harness/routines/system-actions.ts registerSystemAction; work-admission/admission-sources.ts; autonomy/tripwire/revert-executor.ts; pot-eval/bet-flag-reverter.ts. Agent recurrence uses plans:set-schedule with existing authorized actions. |
| Authority ops, coord ops, RPC/endpoint and credential boundaries | B | authority/authority-op-registry.ts; coord-ops/registry.ts; cluster-owner-rpc.ts; endpoint-route/define-route.ts; data-governance/organization-key-registry.ts; workspace-host/hosted-relay-confidentiality-registry.ts. These implement trust boundaries. |
| Derived read/cache, projection, TTL and stream registries | B | derived-reads/registry.ts, expirable-registry.ts, sync/hyperbee/{projection,rate-limiter-registry}.ts, generic/sync query-registry and generic/sse stream-registry. They derive/transport existing facts; new producer functions are source changes. |
| Search surfaces, embeddings, chunkers, census and reliability registries | B | search/{surface-registry,embedder-mode-registry,chunks/registry}.ts; coverage-census/provider-registry.ts; field-reliability-registry.ts; content-lint/registry.ts. Schema/units, source readers and detector logic require reviewed implementation. |
| Shell equivalence substitutions | B | bash-substitution/registry.ts reads bash_tool_substitutions; bash-substitution/pairs/index.ts and registry-drift.ts define audited command/tool pairs and earned tiers. Ordinary rules cannot assert command equivalence or bypass native-tool policy. |
| UI components, panels, intents, shortcuts and design adapters | B | design-adapter/registry.ts, design-adapter-react-tailwind/registry.ts, design-compare/host-registry.ts, ui/intent-registry.ts, shortcut-registry.ts, generic/dock-workbench panel-registry. Implementations are executable UI code; design-phase tools discover/spec/validate them. |
| Bench, experiment, provisioner and creative-lens catalogs | B | provisioner/catalog.ts; external-bench/competitor-registry.ts; llm-testing/targets/*; experiment/descriptors.ts; scout/lenses.ts; gym/primitives.ts and report-set-firewall.ts. Running/binding a measurement exists; adding a new executable methodology or certified binary is implementation work. |
| Admission, hold/change kinds, orientation and lifecycle taxonomies | B | hold-registry.ts, change-kind-catalog.ts, turn-start-orientation.ts, orientation-class-registry.ts, agent-obligations.ts. These are platform lifecycle contracts, not user workflow rules. |
| Session, host, peer, workspace and desktop registration records | A/B split | Public lifecycle tools create the entities; commands/session-registry.ts, desktop/desktop-session-registry.ts, harness/workspace registries and sync peer registries record authenticated runtime presence. registerSession/registerTask/sidecar shutdown callbacks do not constitute a missing behavior-authoring DSL. |

Disposition: extend existing stores for the four C rows; proposed tool names are recommendations pending follow-up design, not newly added verbs. Existing structured checks and subscriptions cover ad-hoc monitoring; built-in detector implementation and authority/protocol changes remain source-reviewed. P-009 records accountable owners and safety/shareability decisions. Paths without a prefix above are under packages/operator-core/lib; libs/db paths refer to libs/papercusp/libs/db.

title: "Creating rules and events without code"
description: "Use agent tools to author, test, enable, execute, and share local rules and event types without editing source code."
type: Insight
discovered: 2026-10-16
status: active
documents:
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/rules/lifecycle.ts"
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/events/saved-event-type.ts"
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/events/emit.ts"
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/cupboard/publish-rule.ts"
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/cupboard/publish-event.ts"
  - "packages/operator-core/lib/events/local-rule-runtime.ts"
plans:
  - "agent-authored-rules-events-and-authoring-gap-audit-2026-10-15"
---

## What this enables

Agents can create local rules and event types through the existing agent tools. Rule authoring stores a disabled revision in Postgres; event authoring uses `events:emit { save: true }` to persist a typed event declaration. These tools extend the existing rule registry and event-key registry rather than creating parallel stores.

## Safe lifecycle

For a rule, use `rules:validate`, `rules:create`, `rules:test`, then `rules:enable`. Creation and edits start disabled. Enabling requires a passing replay for the same revision, and any edit invalidates that proof. `rules:disable` and `rules:delete` remain available as recovery controls. Local rules execute within the author’s live wearer identity, workspace or pot scope, capability ceilings, fire budgets, and existing receipt paths. Authoring a definition does not grant capabilities.

For events, call `events:emit` with `announce: true, save: true`, a description, and an optional synchronous JSON payload schema. Saving declares and catalogs the event type without firing it. A later normal emit validates the payload and wakes matching awaits. Invalid payloads are rejected before dispatch. Event keys are scoped to the workspace and preserve contributor ownership.

## Test before relying on it

Use `rules:test` to replay bounded matching tool or event history. It is a dry run with no executor dispatch and reports unknown when the ledger lacks the required result or condition inputs. Test the matching, nonmatching, disabled, edited, and reloaded cases before enabling. The maintained suites are `packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/rules/lifecycle.test.ts`, `packages/operator-core/lib/events/authored-rule-test.test.ts`, `packages/operator-core/lib/events/local-rule-runtime.integration.test.ts`, and `packages/operator-core/lib/events/saved-event-type.integration.test.ts`.

## Sharing

Use `cupboard:publish-rule { exportOnly: true }` or `cupboard:publish-event { exportOnly: true }` to export a portable package. Export-only writes a local directory and does not contact GitHub or submit a listing. Push the returned directory to the intended mirror, then publish the listing through the normal reviewed Cupboard flow. A fresh workspace installs the package and claims the event or rule through its existing registry seam; installed packages remain inert until explicitly worn or enabled. Sharing carries curated definitions and payload contracts, never local receipts, grants, lifecycle state, or derived measurements.

## Boundaries

The tools do not create executable capability classes, providers, transport adapters, hook implementations, parser instruments, or kernel authority. Those remain reviewed source or plugin contributions. Structured rubric checks, watches, schedules, topics, and voice channels already provide authorable measurement, alerting, recurrence, and communication paths. Disable a rule immediately if its behavior is wrong; deletion is available for cleanup.

dispositionDecision.title: Complete positive disposition chain for the four confirmed authoring gaps
dispositionDecision.body:
Date: 2026-10-16
Supplements D-007: the lexicon receipt is WI-6554700010015605 (not pending). Each confirmed C gap has a verified assigned follow-up, with assignee su-bbfd627f-1859-4ffe-aa04-8c96b24955ea on 2026-10-16. State cells → WI-6554700010015604: propose state:define and state:validate over cell-registry and authorized resolver/check references; high safety; no arbitrary executable resolver or Cupboard authority grants. Themes → WI-6554700010015603: propose themes:create/save parity over saveCustomTheme and its existing validator/store; medium safety; existing reviewed Cupboard package sharing. Templates → WI-6554700010015602: propose templates:create-draft and templates:validate over template-store/template-kit; high safety; reviewed package sharing, no implicit materialization or activation. Lexicon packs → WI-6554700010015605: propose lexicon:create/validate over the generic lexicon-pack resolver; medium safety; reviewed brand-pack sharing with explicit activation. Proposed names are design candidates for those follow-ups, not claims that these new verbs already exist. This plan files and assigns the four gaps; implementing them belongs to their own items.
Related: P-008, P-009

decision.title: Rules and events authoring content brief from the implementation lane
decision.body:
Date: 2026-10-16
Affects: agent-authored-rules-events-and-authoring-gap-audit-2026-10-15
P-001 content-brief supplement from agent-authored-rules-events-and-authoring-gap-audit-2026-10-15 (P-010). Copy to use after verified shipment: Ask your agent to create a rule or event. Rules: rules:validate → rules:create → rules:test → rules:enable; rules:disable and rules:delete reverse activation. An edit invalidates the passing replay. Events: events:emit with announce:true, save:true, description and optional payloadSchema saves a declaration without firing; a later ordinary emit validates the payload and wakes matching awaits. Share through cupboard:publish-rule or cupboard:publish-event; exportOnly:true produces a local portable package without publishing. Authoring grants no capabilities; local execution retains the author’s live identity and scope, and installed packages remain inert until worn. Guide: docs:get {slugs:["agent-insights/creating-rules-and-events-without-code"],harness:"papercusp"}; projected path apps/operator-docs/src/content/docs/agent-insights/creating-rules-and-events-without-code.mdx. Shipment is NOT yet verified; retain the existing coming-soon labels until the rules/events plan has a verified shipped verdict. This supplement provides working-tool wording and does not claim ownership of this page implementation.
Related: P-001
